key_insight: PoreML unifies porous-media data generation, model training, and evaluation to enable reliable machine-learning prediction of multiphase flow in complex pore geometries.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports better design and forecasting for applications such as CO2 storage, fuel cells, and packaging by providing reproducible pore-scale simulation data and benchmark tests.
method: GPU-native lattice Boltzmann solver for reproducible pore-scale data generation
3.3 TB dataset with 560 runs and 158,546 time steps across four scenarios
Unified evaluation for one-step prediction, autoregressive rollout, and physical consistency
evidence_signal: The benchmark includes five model architectures and two transfer tests, spanning larger domains and synthetic-to-micro-CT generalization.
watch_item: Performance may still be sensitive to domain shift, especially when transferring models to larger geometries or real micro-CT-derived structures.
paper_title: PoreML: A Data-Driven Framework for Learning Multiphase Flow in Porous Media
